headline: Firefighters Build Custom Ramp After Woman Trapped by Theft
meta_description: Firefighters stepped in to build a custom wheelchair ramp for a woman who had been confined to her home after her previous ramp was stolen.
summary_short: A woman was trapped inside her home for days after thieves stole her wheelchair ramp. Local firefighters learned of her situation and built her a custom replacement.
body:
A woman found herself confined to her home for days after her wheelchair ramp was stolen. When firefighters learned of her situation, they took action—building her a custom ramp to restore her independence and mobility.

The theft had left her without access to the outside world, unable to leave her home until the ramp could be replaced. The discovery of her predicament sparked a compassionate response from the fire department, who saw an opportunity to help someone in genuine need.

The newly built custom ramp represents more than just a practical solution. It's a reminder that community members can step in when others face unexpected hardship, transforming a moment of crisis into an act of genuine human kindness.
quick_facts: Woman trapped inside home after wheelchair ramp was stolen
Firefighters built a custom replacement ramp
She had been confined for days before help arrived
